records.statement: Printed heading 'Of Marriage' introduces a new significator allocation, separate from Alkindus aphorisms.
Printed side heading 'It shall be' labels the five perfection routes, with a margin note about exchanged terms and triplicity dignities.
records.limit: Printed side note is not handwriting; these are alternative testimonies.

records.statement: Printed side heading 'Which love most, or desire it most' labels the first-versus-seventh lord attachment comparisons.
records.limit: Heading rather than independently verified affection.

records.statement: The author adds that other applying significators indicate more affection.
records.limit: Applying direction matters; later printed317 has contradictory interpretation.

records.statement: Printed subsection 'What manner of person he or she is' begins the period personality-characterization rules.
records.limit: Handwritten annotations beside the heading are not Lilly's words.

records.statement: Printed subsection 'How they shall agree after Marriage' precedes aspects, reception and the house-strength discussion.
records.limit: Not evidence of any observed marriage.

records.statement: The preceding page begins a source clause about first and seventh lords in square/opposition and an impeded Moon-related ruler beholding the ascendant, continued onto printed310.
records.limit: Cross-page original context and uncertain grouping must be retained.

records.statement: Printed heading 'Who shall be the cause of their Strife, or the authour of their Good' precedes both discord and positive material help.
records.limit: The gifts/benefits clauses are not all negative disagreements.
